Dein Home of IT: REWE digital

Wir sind das Zuhause für alle, die sich in der digitalen Welt tummeln, ein Tech-Team, in dem IT- und Non-IT-Spezialist:innen zusammen Innovationen für den Handel und den Alltag von Millionen Menschen erwecken. Willkommen in deinem Home of IT!
Deine Fachdomäne: Procurement Solutions (PSL)

Mit innovativen IT-Lösungen unterstützt die PSL zentrale Prozesse der REWE Group: vom Einkauf über Category Management bis zur Abrechnung, mit Fokus auf unsere Artikel- und Lieferantenstammdaten als Grundlage effizienter Prozesse entlang der Wertschöpfungskette.
Deine Rolle: Information Security Manager (m/w/d)

Als Information Security Manager (m/w/d) bringst du Sicherheitskultur in die Produktteams der PSL. Du unterstützt sie bei der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb sicherer Software und sorgst dafür, dass Security von Anfang an in den Entwicklungsprozess integriert wird. Mit einem starken Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung befähigst du unsere Entwickler:innen zu robusten und sicheren Anwendungen.
Aufgaben, die dich weiterbringen:

Du fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produktorganisation und der 2nd Line of defense und bist erste Ansprechperson für die 2nd Line innerhalb der Domäne
Du stellst sicher, dass die Domänenleitung, Product Owner, Chief Product Owner und Engineering Manager (Führungsteam) über aktuelle Vorgaben, einschließlich rechtlicher Anforderungen und deren Umsetzungsgrad informiert sind
Du berätst das Führungsteam deiner Fachdomäne zum Sicherheitsstatus
Du unterstützt bei der Erhebung und Kommunikation von Sicherheitskennzahlen und beim Risikomanagement
Du förderst innerhalb der Produktteams die Einhaltung von Sicherheitsanforderungen und das Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit
Du treibst die Priorisierung, Bewertung und Koordination von Maßnahmen zur Optimierung der Informationssicherheit, einschließlich der Kontrolle der Umsetzung aktiv voran
Du unterstützt den Bereich Information Security bei der Entwicklung und Abstimmung von Sicherheitsrichtlinien, sowie bei der Durchführung und Koordination von Penetrationstests

Features, die dich ausmachen:

Zuallererst deine Persönlichkeit: Deine überzeugende Kommunikation und ausgeprägte Koordinationsfähigkeiten für die effektive Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams und Ebenen zeichnen dich aus
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Stakeholdermanagement oder in der Projektleitung und in der IT-Sicherheit sowie Kenntnisse der relevanten Sicherheitsanforderungen und deren Umsetzung
Hohe Affinität zu Security-Themen und kontinuierliches Interesse an persönlicher Weiterbildung
Erste Erfahrung in organisatorischen und prozessualen Aspekten der Informationssicherheit und mit agilen Arbeitsweisen
Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik oder Informationssicherheit
Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse setzen wir aufgrund der Schnittstellenfunktion voraus
Deine Begeisterung für die IT-Sicherheit und dein kühler Kopf in herausfordernden Situationen runden dein Profil ab

Basics, die das Leben noch besser machen:

Deine Life-Work-Integration durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub + regionale Brauchtumstage, Auszeitmodelle (Sabbatical, Pflegeauszeit etc.) und Betriebskindergarten.
Wir investieren in deine Zukunft. Mit deinem jährlichen Weiterbildungsbudget kannst du in Bezug auf deine individuelle Skillentwicklung lernen. Also bleib neugierig und sammle auf unserer eigenen Lernplattform, dem "IT Learning Hub", auf Fachkonferenzen, in Fachbüchern oder in einem von vielen kostenlosen Workshops aus unserem Learning Canvas neuen Input für dich und uns alle.
Updates für dich bei Inhouse Workshops und Events, wie dem Hackathon und Tech Talks sowie wöchentlichen Stand-Ups, regelmäßigen Tech All-Hands und Open Door-Formaten.
Dein Impact, weil du Anwendungen und Services für Millionen von Menschen entwickelst - mit über 1 Milliarde Datensätzen täglich, auf über 6 Millionen Handys, 32.000 Kassen oder in 7.300 Märkten.
Dein entspannter Arbeitsweg mit dem vergünstigten Deutschlandticket, einem Jobrad und Parkplätzen direkt vor der Tür.
Unsere Netzwerke wie DITO - different together, SHINE, f.ernetzt, WomEngineers @REWE digital sowie Women's Drive machen uns zu einer bunten Community und unterstützen dich bei deiner persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
Vorteile eines Konzerns für dich, z.B. in Form von Rabatten bei REWE, PENNY, toom Baumarkt und der DERTOUR Group, einer Rundumversorgung durch umfangreiche Gesundheitsleistungen, einer Unterstützung deiner Altersversorgung in Form von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen und der REWE-Pensionskasse, Sonderleistungen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld uvm.

This is a role that will require frequent travel and overnight stays in Europe.

Project Revenue Managed: Multi million Euros

1. Manages, oversee’ s and coordinates all aspects of Divisional project activities including, but not limited to, the following: planning, qualifying booked margin, review of proposals and bookings for the team. Coaches, Mentors the Divisional projects team to improve an individual’s skillset and productivity. Overall responsibility for customer satisfaction on all Projects and deliverables within the Division.
2. Overall responsibility for execution of contracts – estimated cost vs. actual cost;
review of contracts; supervision of Managers and subcontractors; planning and
scheduling contracts, preparation of invoices, and collections.

organization as and when required and maintains accurate and up to date job cost
records, and other control records necessary for processing of internal and external
reports.

improve execution and provide additional value to customers in a cost-effective
manner.
6. Proactively communicates with and seeks feedback from all customers. Seeks to
continuously improve customer satisfaction. .
7. Meets with their and their PM’s customers on a regular basis to ensure that we are
providing quality installations and meeting their individual needs.
8. Utilizes financial systems to review actual vs. estimated contract costs and to provide
timely and accurate financial reports for both their and their teams Projects.
9. Manages individual performance and personal development of assigned Project
Management team resources including appraisals along with performance of
subcontractors and LSP’s.
10. Supervises colleagues (typically, Project Managers, Project Specialists, Engineering
Specialists, Customer Support Specialists, and/or Installers) in a manner that
maintains morale, skills proficiency and productivity. Assist with Recruitment and hire
team members as required. Managerial responsibilities include but are not limited to:
mentoring, coaching and developing colleagues; planning, assigning and directing
work; performance management; project budget.
11. Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested or required by the
operations management team.

Job Skills Requirements:

Strong management skills related to Project and People Management
Customer Focus – Maintaining awareness of and seeking to meet of the needs and wants of the customer
Excellent communication skills both oral and written
Leadership Orientation – Actively seeks ways in which to act as a role model, guide, develop and mentor others within the Divisional Department; Strong team leadership, team building and facilitation skills
Initiative – Engages in proactive behavior and looks for new project opportunities
Adaptability – Responds effectively to changes in situation or information
Strong financial analytical skills including cost control
Excellent Microsoft Outlook, Project, Excel, Word and Power Point skills

Education Requirements:

Higher Education or University Graduate in Project Management.

Experience Requirements:
Minimum of Two years of previous Senior Project Management, either in service, field or office-based Project Management experience
Experience of Management in one or more of the following industries preferred: Electronic Security, Network/IT.
Previous People Management experience
Certifications & Licenses:

Project Management Institute (PMP/PMI) certification preferred but not essential; industry-specific certifications and/or licenses required; must have valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager, IT & Cybersecurity
· Jakarta (on-site with client visits) · Full-time
Amaan Solutions (PT Amaan Life Solutions) is a Jakarta-based IT systems integrator with a strong concentration in cybersecurity. We are trusted by major Indonesian banks, government institutions, and enterprises in the natural resources sector. We are small, profitable, and growing, and we work with leading global technology principals to design, implement and manage:
IT infrastructure and enterprise systems, such as banking application infrastructure
Systems integration, including identity and access management (IAM / SSO) and integration with enterprise platforms such as SAP
Cybersecurity: digital risk protection, threat intelligence, endpoint security and XDR / managed detection and response
Vendor risk management and cyber range solutions
Managed services and managed advisory

Our clients do not buy a box from us. They rely on us as an advisor who understands their risk. Our next chapter is building our own technology products, and the people we hire now will shape that.We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to own delivery of our IT and cybersecurity projects end to end, from kickoff to go-live to renewal. You will work directly with the founder, sit in front of clients, and keep our engineers focused and unblocked.
This is not a coordinator role. You will need to understand the technology well enough to challenge a vendor, explain a risk to a bank's CIO or CISO, and help shape a proposal that wins.We are deliberately hiring someone early in their career with room to grow, and we will invest in you. The path we have in mind:
First 12 months: run your own portfolio of client projects and become the client's trusted day-to-day contact.
Years 2–3: take ownership of key accounts, support pre-sales and renewals, and mentor junior engineers and PMs.
Beyond: grow into a leadership role, such as Head of Delivery or lead of a practice area such as cybersecurity.

Project Delivery

Plan and run multiple IT and cybersecurity projects at once: scope, timeline, budget, resources and risks
Lead implementations across infrastructure, enterprise software, systems integration and security solutions (such as threat intelligence, XDR/MDR and IAM) together with our engineers and global principals
Run kickoffs, status meetings, UAT, go-live and handover, and keep clear project documentation
Manage vendors and principals: license processes, escalations, SLAs and support tickets
Spot delivery risks early and escalate with a proposed fix, not just a problem

Client Relationships

Be the main day-to-day contact for clients' IT, security and procurement teams
Translate technical findings into business risk that executives understand
Prepare and present progress reports and project reviews, including threat findings on security projects

Business Growth

Support pre-sales: discovery meetings, solution scoping, proof-of-concepts and demos
Help write proposals, technical specifications and tender documents
Find upsell and renewal opportunities within your accounts and help close them with the founder

Team

Coordinate engineers' workload across projects and help keep the team from being stretched thin
Improve how we deliver: templates, checklists and lessons learned

Must Have

Bachelor's degree in engineering (informatics, computer, electrical, industrial or similar)
4–5 years of experience in IT or cybersecurity, with at least 2 years managing or co-leading client projects
Experience at an IT systems integrator, technology or security vendor, MSSP, consultancy, or a bank's or enterprise's IT team
Solid technical grounding in IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud, Linux, databases) and enterprise applications, plus a working understanding of cybersecurity (endpoint security, SIEM/SOC, IAM, threat intelligence)
Strong communication in Bahasa Indonesia and professional English, written and spoken; comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders
Commercial instinct: you can listen for a client's real problem and help turn it into a deal
Organised, calm under pressure, and able to juggle several projects without dropping details
Willing to travel to client sites in Jakarta and occasionally outside

Nice to have

Hands-on experience delivering cybersecurity projects (a strong plus)
Experience with Indonesian banking or government client
Experience with tenders and procurement documentation
We are looking for someone at the 4–5 year mark specifically: experienced enough to run projects on their own, and early enough in their career that we can train and grow them into a leader.

What we Offer

A clear path toward a leadership role, with direct mentorship from the founder
Exposure to high-stakes projects for Indonesia's leading banks and institutions
Hands-on work with global technology and cybersecurity principals and their latest platforms
Budget for certifications and training (PM, technical, security and vendor certifications)
Competitive salary plus performance bonus, including incentives on deals you help close
BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
A small team where your work is visible and your ideas get used
A chance to help build Amaan's own security products as we grow

jobs.title: Network Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
About ECI

ECI
is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.

At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by our commitment to empowering our employees around the world
.

ECI is a leading managed services provider serving the alternative investment and financial services industry. We are seeking a Network Implementation Manager to lead the team responsible for deploying, configuring, and handing off enterprise network solutions across our global client base. This role requires someone who is technically sharp enough to command respect from senior engineers and commercially astute enough to manage delivery timelines, client expectations, and team performance simultaneously. The right candidate has deep network engineering roots and has deliberately grown into a people management role — they know the difference between being the best engineer on the team and building the best engineering team.

This role is hybrid for candidates based in Dallas TX area.

Key Responsibilities

People Management & Team Development

Directly manage a team of Network Implementation Engineers across project delivery lifecycle; set clear performance expectations, conduct structured 1:1s, and own individual development plans.
Build a culture of execution discipline — ticket hygiene, change management compliance, documentation quality, and rigorous project close-out.
Identify skill gaps and build structured training and certification pathways aligned to ECI’s service portfolio.
Manage performance formally and informally; address issues directly, constructively, and on record when required.
Participate in hiring decisions for the implementation function, including technical assessments and structured panel interviews.

Project Delivery & Program Management

Own end-to-end delivery of network implementation projects spanning new client onboarding, infrastructure refreshes, office builds, and technology migrations.
Define and enforce project intake, scoping, scheduling, and resource allocation standards across the team.
Maintain active visibility across all open workstreams; surface and resolve blockers before they become client escalations.
Drive post-implementation reviews and root cause analysis; translate findings into repeatable process improvements for the team.
Coordinate with Client Services, Solutions Architecture, and pre-sales to align implementation timelines with client commitments and ECI delivery standards.

Technical Standards & Oversight

Serve as the technical authority for ECI’s implementation standards covering Cisco (Catalyst, Nexus, IOS-XE/XR), Palo Alto firewalls, Meraki, and SD-WAN platforms.
Review and approve low-level designs (LLDs) and implementation runbooks before execution.
Establish and enforce configuration standards that ensure consistency, repeatability, and alignment with client security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, NIST, HIPAA).
Serve as escalation point for complex in-flight technical issues; engage hands-on when warranted while ensuring the team learns from every resolution.
Champion Zero Trust and SASE architecture principles within ECI’s implementation workflows.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

Own implementation status communication to client stakeholders; translate technical risk into clear business impact language.
Represent the implementation team in internal delivery reviews, capacity planning, and service improvement forums.
Maintain ECI’s documentation standard across implementation plans, network diagrams, as-built records, and configuration baselines — ensuring clean handoffs to managed services teams.

Qualifications

Required

10+ years of progressive network engineering experience with a demonstrable track record in enterprise implementation, ideally within an MSP or multi-client environment.
3+ years of direct people management — you have hired engineers, set goals, handled performance, and actively developed talent.
Deep technical proficiency in Cisco networking (Catalyst, Nexus, IOS-XE/XR), Palo Alto firewalls (App-ID, Threat Prevention, VPN, Panorama), and wireless (WLC, Meraki MR/MS/MX).
Strong working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), VLANs, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6 fundamentals.
Proven ability to run multiple concurrent implementation projects with accountability for schedules, resources, and stakeholder communication.
Solid understanding of security frameworks, compliance standards, and change management governance in regulated client environments.

Preferred

Active CCNP, CCIE, or PCNSE certification; equivalent demonstrated expertise considered.
Experience with SD-WAN (Cisco Viptela, VeloCloud) and SASE / Zero Trust architecture in client deployments.
Familiarity with automation tooling (Python, Ansible) to drive repeatability and reduce manual effort across the team.
Experience with network monitoring platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, Meraki Insights) and using telemetry data to drive delivery quality.
Hedge fund, financial services, or similarly regulated client-facing environment experience is a strong plus.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.

Who We Are Looking For

Beyond credentials, we are hiring for a specific leadership profile. The right candidate:

Communicates expectations without ambiguity and follows through consistently. Leads with clarity.
Engineers respect them because they know the stack — not just the title. Commands technical credibility.
Holds the team and themselves to high execution standards without micromanaging. Drives accountability.
Focused on delivery quality and reliability, not just activity volume. Solves for client outcomes.
Understands the job is to build the best team — not to be the best individual engineer on it. Scales through people.

ECI’s culture is all about connection -
connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and the range for this role is a maximum of $142,000 annually with flexible PTO, health benefit eligibility the first of the month, life insurance, pet insurance, 401K and so much more! If you believe you’d be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever, we’d like to hear from you!!

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Oversee an agreed scope of work and/or the operational workload of a team or contractors; ensuring allocated work is completed/resources are fully utilised in order to deliver against an agreed programme of work
Work within established financial systems to independently produce plans and schedules and track and manage budgets, highlighting variances in order to manage and control project delivery targets
Deliver a number of small to medium scale projects or programmes of work, ensuring appropriate use of resources and budgets to deliver the required scope of work within set deadlines

Provide advice to colleagues surrounding behaviours, to ensure adherence to internal and external compliance processes
Analyse and review a range of data to identify key existing and emerging themes and trends. Use own and others’ analysis to provide recommendations that support project decision-making
Use own knowledge and experience of industry best practice to review and analyse project processes and policies, providing insightful recommendations that support senior management to improve processes and systems
Interact effectively and proactively across the organisation, seeking to develop ways to support collaboration and ensure projects/programmes can be delivered to meet internal customer expectations
Advise senior management on issues relating to own project, providing subject matter advice in order to support successful delivery in line with project objectives and strategies
Liaise and collaborate with clients and stakeholders, in order to ensure all parties are informed and aware of project progress and expectations
Responsible for setting project delivery approach and plan in consultation with key stakeholders
Establish project delivery plans and appropriate control mechanisms to assure delivery
Responsible for performance management of project team / resource

Qualifications & Experience:

Possess the skills and experience to actively support the internal team and manage more junior staff on technically complex projects/programme of works typically ranging between £5m and £150m
Able to work closely with external stakeholders to build client relationships, and manage business relationships at middle-management level
Experience in NEC Contract Suites
In depth knowledge of the Defence & Security sector and construction/built asset sector.
Capable of taking a project through from inception to completion
Ability to obtain BPSS clearance
Ability to obtain SC clearance

Experience of coaching and mentoring more junior colleagues and emerging leadership skills
Ability to obtain DV clearance

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of complex projects and interrelated programs from initiation through completion and transition to operations. This position provides strategic and operational leadership to cross-functional teams, manages client and subcontractor relationships, and ensures projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements.

The Senior Project Manager serves as a primary client-facing representative and works closely with senior leadership, program teams, customers, vendors, and subcontractors to achieve project objectives, manage risk, resolve issues, and identify opportunities for continued program growth.

Position is located in Okinawa, Japan. Relocation assistance, within specific maximums, is provided.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project & Program Management

Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout of complex projects and interrelated initiatives.
Establish project objectives, priorities, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and performance measures.
Translate client requirements and contractual obligations into actionable project plans and operational strategies.
Manage project scope, requirements, schedules, resources, dependencies, and change control.
Monitor project performance and provide regular status reports, briefings, and recommendations to clients and senior management.
Facilitate project reviews, stakeholder meetings, and executive-level briefings.

Budget, Resource & Risk Management

Develop and manage project budgets, cost estimates, staffing plans, resource requirements, and schedules.
Monitor project financial performance and identify variances, risks, and corrective actions.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project, operational, technical, contractual, and schedule risks.
Determine and implement appropriate contingency and recovery plans.
Coordinate the selection and management of subcontractors, vendors, and other external resources.

Client & Stakeholder Management

Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders.
Build and maintain effective relationships with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal leadership.
Facilitate communication across project teams and ensure timely and accurate exchange of information.
Understand client priorities and long-term objectives and align project execution accordingly.
Provide project management guidance, training, and mentoring to customers, vendors, and project team members.

Team Leadership

Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives and contractual commitments.
Assign responsibilities and coordinate resources to meet established schedules and deliverables.
Coach, mentor, and support project team members in achieving performance and project goals.
Promote collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and effective problem resolution.
Lead teams in identifying and resolving technical, operational, and resource-related issues.

Contract & Business Development Support

Support senior management with proposals, bids, statements of work, contracts, pricing, estimates, staffing plans, and project schedules.
Identify and develop opportunities for additional services, contract growth, and program expansion.
Ensure project execution remains consistent with contractual requirements and applicable laws, regulations, policies, and standards.

Performance & Process Improvement

Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), project metrics, and reporting mechanisms.
Identify opportunities to improve project management processes, tools, systems, and workflows.
Evaluate and implement automated project management and reporting systems as appropriate.
Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, industry standards, project management methodologies, and best practices.
Recommend process improvements and strategies to increase efficiency, quality, and project performance.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Project Management, Business Administration, Management, Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Operations Management, or a related field.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification required.
CompTIA Security+ certification required.
Active Secret security clearance required.
Minimum 8 years of progressive project management experience, preferably supporting government, defense, or federal contracts.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary projects and cross-functional teams.
Experience managing project budgets, schedules, staffing, subcontractors, risks, and deliverables.
Strong knowledge of project management principles, methodologies, and best practices.
Experience working directly with government or commercial clients and senior stakeholders.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Certifications & Security

Required

Project Management Professional (PMP)
CompTIA Security+
Active Secret security clearance

Project Manager – Defence SATCOM Capability

Key details

Employment: Full-time
Location: ACT
Work arrangement: On-site; no remote work
Security clearance: NV1 minimum (
Commencement: ASAP

Role overview

BRG is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join a Defence capability delivery core team, planning, coordinating and delivering critical satellite communications (SATCOM) systems that enable secure, resilient long-range communications for Australian Defence Force operations. The position oversees multiple acquisition and capability development work packages, including delivery and integration of geostationary (GEO) and low earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks.

The role also explores future capability development through risk-reduction activities assessing emerging wideband SATCOM technologies and informing strategic investment decisions for a major Defence land communications program. The Project Manager works across Defence, industry and operational stakeholders, translating complex technical requirements into disciplined delivery outcomes.

Key responsibilities

Project delivery

Support the project management team lead in end-to-end delivery of multiple work packages.
Maintain integrated schedules and manage critical-path risks spanning acquisition, engineering, cyber, safety, testing and sustainment.
Manage contractual, commercial and financial obligations, contractor performance and change control.
Exercise delegated project management responsibilities as a core member of the delivery team.
Coordinate delivery teams to manage interdependencies, resources and technical integration points.

Planning, controls and governance

Develop and maintain project management plans, schedules, risk and issue artefacts, cost controls and reporting.
Produce concise, executive-ready reports for the team lead, governance boards and senior stakeholders.
Prepare inputs for gate reviews, investment processes and senior submissions.
Support wider project management planning and reporting activities.

Integration and technical coordination

Coordinate integration across satellite communications, battlefield tactical networks, tactical communications networks and relevant platforms.
Oversee user evaluations, acceptance test and evaluation (AT&E), and operational test and evaluation (OT&E), including issue resolution.
Work with engineering, test and integrated logistics support (ILS) teams to resolve complex technical and operational matters.

Stakeholder engagement and sustainment transition

Engage Army headquarters, land communications capability stakeholders, sustainment groups and industry partners.
Navigate complex stakeholder relationships and build consensus on delivery outcomes.
Ensure Fundamental Inputs to Capability (FIC), including training, documentation, spares and support systems, are ready for introduction into service (IIS).
Lead sustainment transition with the receiving sustainment organisation, defining support arrangements and configuration baselines.
Coordinate resources preparing for sustainment and manage transition-related risks.

Essential criteria

Relevant tertiary qualifications or more than 12 years of relevant industry and/or domain experience.
Current, relevant project management experience, including concurrent and interdependent work packages.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging Defence, Capability Acquisition and Sustainment Group (CASG) and industry stakeholders.
Ability to assimilate complex technical detail and translate it into deliverable project plans.
Collaborative stakeholder management, sound interpersonal judgement and disciplined project controls in uncertain environments.
Focus on delivery outcomes and sound understanding of training, sustainment, doctrine and other Fundamental Inputs to Capability.
Applicable Defence security clearance; NV1 minimum used pending confirmation of the client's required level.

Desirable criteria

Recognised project management accreditation or qualifications, such as AIPM, PMI or PRINCE2.
Experience in satellite communications, deployable networks, waveform integration, vehicle C4 systems or Defence timing architectures.
Familiarity with ASDEFCON, ILS frameworks and Defence certification and cyber-worthiness processes.
Defence and/or CASG experience, particularly Army acquisition projects.

jobs.description:
About SleekFlow

SleekFlow is an AI Suite for Revenue-Driving Conversations. We are trusted by over 7,000 enterprises globally. But we are more than just a SaaS company; we are an AI-native movement redefining the B2C relationship across 70+ countries.
At our core is AgentFlow—an AI GTM workforce that learns, improves, and acts as a self-healing knowledge base for businesses. From first-click conversion to long-term retention, we turn every conversation into a data-backed growth opportunity. Headquartered in Singapore with a global presence in Hong Kong, the UAE, and the US, we are looking for exceptional people to help us build an AI operating system that matters.

Join us and rewrite how the world engages at scale.

Role

We are looking for a Strategy & Business Operations Manager. In this role you are the execution engine of the CEO’s Office. You turn leadership priorities and decisions into results: scope the work, align the teams involved, drive implementation across functions, and track it through to measurable outcomes. You also own the company-wide pricing layer and run the company's operating cadences. Analysis is part of the job, but success is measured by what gets implemented, not by what gets recommended.

Responsibilities

Company-wide pricing & commercial policy

Own the company-level pricing and packaging strategy, and prepare pricing recommendations for leadership decisions
Maintain the price book and pricing governance, including discount policy and approvals
Support Sales on non-standard and partner deals
Work with Product Managers to keep product-level pricing consistent with the overall pricing strategy

Strategic analysis & special projects

Lead strategic analyses and business cases on priorities set by the CEO and leadership
Monitor the competitive and market landscape, and proactively bring insights that shape company direction
Model financial and operating scenarios to support planning and cost decisions

Revenue & cross-team operations

Identify and improve cross-team operating processes, with a focus on revenue impact
Lead cross-team projects from scoping through to delivery, coordinating across functions
Set up project governance and hand over improved processes to their owners

Planning & operating rhythm

Run the company's planning and operating cadences, including business reviews and leadership syncs
Facilitate OKR, target and incentive setting across departments
Track leadership decisions and action items through to closure

Board, investor & lender support

Prepare data and analysis for board, investor and lender reporting

How you’ll work

Implementation:
turn decisions into plans and drive them to results
Recommendations:
go beyond analysis to clear, prioritised recommendations and next steps
Stakeholder management:
build trust and alignment with leaders across the company, and push back constructively when needed
Communications:
communicate decisions and changes clearly to leadership and wider teams

Skills and Qualifications

3 to 6 years in pricing, data and strategy, corporate / management consulting, management office, BizOps, or a strategy / finance team at a SaaS or tech company
Strong with data: builds pricing, unit economics and scenario models from scratch
Highly comfortable and proficient with the use of AI to streamline and enhance work
Strong with implementation and execution: bring projects to life and track results end-to-end
Detail and closure: answers every part of a question, closes loops without being chased
Communicates clearly on decisions, rationales, options, recommendations and guidances
Comfortable with senior leaders: can run a meeting with department heads and push back with data
Process design: has mapped and redesigned a cross-team workflow (e.g. lead-to-cash, sales ops, RevOps) and made it stick with the teams that run it
Project management experience, such as running cross-functional launches with several teams and dependencies
Fluent English; Cantonese or Mandarin a plus

Nice to have

B2B SaaS pricing and packaging, deal desk or revenue operations exposure
Has worked in a high-growth startup or scale-up, so is used to vague briefs and changing priorities
Has led change management, getting frontline teams to actually adopt new processes and not only redesign them
Has built automations or workflows with tools (e.g. n8n, Zapier, HubSpot workflows)
Understands SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, LTV:CAC and gross margin, and how pricing moves them
Multi-market experience across Asia, the Middle East or Latin America

Our Culture Code

Open-mindedness
– We welcome different viewpoints and give and take feedback openly, always ready to challenge our own assumptions.
Collaboration
– We have each other's back, share knowledge freely, and treat every teammate with equal respect.
Growth
– We pursue continuous improvement, embrace new challenges, and treat mistakes as chances to learn.
Ownership
– We take initiative, see things through, and hold ourselves accountable for the outcome.
Grit & Adaptability
– We stay resilient through setbacks and adapt to change with patience and persistence.

What We Offer

Attractive compensation package including a 13th-month salary
High on-target earnings
Stock options in a rapidly growing startup
A fun, diverse, and international team culture
Comprehensive group medical insurance
Allowances for transportation, snacks, and team lunches
Examination & education allowance
Paid birthday leave
Flexible work-from-home policy
“Work From Anywhere” scheme
Rewarding continuous learning from experienced team leads
Many more exciting perks and growth opportunities!

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.

SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

jobs.title: Strategy & Business Operations Manager, Wolt Drive
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Role

Wolt is on a growth journey as part of the DoorDash family, together with Deliveroo. Drive
is our delivery-as-a-service business: we let merchants offer fast, reliable delivery in their own channels (their webshop, app or ordering system), powered by the Wolt and Deliveroo courier networks. We're now bringing Drive across Wolt and Deliveroo countries together into one EMEA business
, with one team and a clear ambition: grow fast and build a business that stands on its own feet.

A growing share of that scaling comes from outside restaurants: grocers, retailers, pharmacies and other eComm players who want on-demand and same-day delivery for their own customers. Their needs can be very different from restaurants: bigger baskets, scheduled and batched deliveries, larger and heavier items, longer distances and more complex integrations. This brings us to you, our next Manager, Strategy & Operations
for Grocery & Retail Drive.

You'll own this segment across EMEA, from strategy and planning to pricing, product requirements and performance. You'll work hand in hand with our regional commercial teams, who own the partner relationships, and with Product, Logistics, Finance and our Marketplace grocery & retail teams. You'll join the Drive EMEA Strategy & Operations team and report to the Director of Strategy & Operations, Drive EMEA.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the Grocery & Retail strategy and annual plan for Drive EMEA: where we play, which partners we go after, and the growth and profitability we commit to.
Set the commercial framework for the segment, including pricing guidelines, deal economics and investment cases for our largest partnerships, together with the regional commercial leads.
Act as the voice of grocery and retail partners towards Product and Logistics, turning commercial needs such as scheduled delivery or large and heavy items into sized, prioritized requirements.
Run performance management for the segment: track growth, unit economics and service levels for our biggest partners, spot what's off and drive the fix with the teams involved.
Shape how Drive works with our Marketplace grocery & retail teams, so partners get one joined-up offer from us.
Turn wins into playbooks that country teams can reuse, from the first pitch to launch and scale-up.

Our humble expectations

5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, business development, commercial roles or management consulting, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just recommendations.
Strong commercial and analytical skills: you can build a deal P&L or a segment plan from scratch, and defend it in front of a partner's leadership or our own.
Proven ability to get things done across a matrix organization without direct authority, working with regional teams, Product, Logistics and Finance.
You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in your daily work, for example in analysis, planning and ways of working, and look for new ways to apply them to elevate you - whilst maintaining strong judgement that comes from personal understanding complex systems
Structured thinking and clear, concise communication in English, both written and spoken.
Willingness to travel occasionally across our EMEA markets.

Seen as a strong advantage:

Background in retail, grocery, e-commerce, logistics or on-demand delivery, either in-house or advising companies in these sectors.
Experience with B2B platform or delivery-as-a-service businesses.

Why you'll love it

🚀 Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving business at the moment it's being built, across two of Europe's best-known delivery brands
🛒 A segment to own: Work with some of the biggest grocery and retail brands in Europe, and see what you write end up on the product roadmap
🤩 Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career with direct access to DoorDash's global Drive experience and room to grow as the segment scales
💪 Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference
💙 Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

Next steps

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV in English and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

is our delivery-as-a-service business: we let merchants offer fast, reliable delivery in their own channels (their webshop, app or ordering system), powered by the Wolt and Deliveroo courier networks. We're now bringing Drive across Wolt and Deliveroo countries together into one EMEA business

for Grocery & Retail Drive.

You'll own this segment across EMEA, from strategy and planning to pricing, product requirements and performance. Run performance management for the segment: track growth, unit economics and service levels for our biggest partners, spot what's off and drive the fix with the teams involved.
Shape how Drive works with our Marketplace grocery & retail teams, so partners get one joined-up offer from us.
Turn wins into playbooks that country teams can reuse, from the first pitch to launch and scale-up.

Our humble expectations

5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, business development, commercial roles or management consulting, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just recommendations.
Strong commercial and analytical skills: you can build a deal P&L or a segment plan from scratch, and defend it in front of a partner's leadership or our own.
Proven ability to get things done across a matrix organization without direct authority, working with regional teams, Product, Logistics and Finance.
You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in your daily work, for example in analysis, planning and ways of working, and look for new ways to apply them to elevate you - whilst maintaining strong judgement that comes from personal understanding complex systems
Structured thinking and clear, concise communication in English, both written and spoken.

Background in retail, grocery, e-commerce, logistics or on-demand delivery, either in-house or advising companies in these sectors.
Experience with B2B platform or delivery-as-a-service businesses.

Why you'll love it

🚀 Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving business at the moment it's being built, across two of Europe's best-known delivery brands

Next steps

This is a client-facing role with focus and importance on maintaining long-term relationships with our customers through continuous and meaningful delivery. Value & Problem Framing: Articulate client value and frame the problem worth solving - what outcome the client is actually buying.

Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal and client stakeholders to ensure both functional and commercial objectives are met.
Scope Management: Lead discovery and manage scope - including using AI to rapidly prototype and test ideas - to deliver maximum value, while ensuring efficient use of resources.
Success Measures: Define the hypotheses and measurable success criteria that define what good looks like.
Team Coordination: Keep product delivery teams informed of upcoming work and broadly communicate relevant context and problems faced to build a shared understanding of the product direction.
Agentic-first: very comfortable using AI to rapidly prototype, test hypotheses, and accelerate discovery.
Proven experience as a Product Strategist or similar role in a software development environment. This is not a traditional Product Owner role. Transferable skills will be beneficial, although a natural curiosity and willingness to adapt to a new and exciting way of working will be key to succeed in this role.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and principles.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with stakeholders to define problems and the measurable outcomes that matter.
Familiarity with product management tools and software.

Propellerhead is a leading software services company that designs, delivers, and maintains large-scale, custom-built digital platforms across a range of technologies. We build software by structuring solutions in a product-centric manner and focusing on continuously delivering measurable outcomes into production. Opportunity for professional growth and development.
Fortnightly knowledge sharing sessions, with lunch.
Competitive salary. Employee Share Purchase Scheme offering.

The analyst translates complex technical intelligence—including eCrime and APT activity—into actionable security and risk insights, sector-relevant risk narratives, and executive-aligned guidance, empowering customers to make informed decisions for their industry environment. ESET Research is a team of 30+ researchers all over the world who analyze complex cyber-espionage and cybercrime operations. We work in collaboration with other internal teams to improve ESET products and create resilient malware detections.

Our primary goal is to understand how threat groups operate in order to better protect our customers and disrupt malicious activities. We write private reports that are available to ESET Threat Intelligence customers.

We share our knowledge publicly on ESET’s blog, https://www.welivesecurity.com/research/, and at technical conferences all around the world (Virus Bulletin, Black Hat, RSA, Botconf, etc.).

Industry-focused threat intelligence

Security research and vulnerability disclosures affecting sector-relevant technology stacks

Broader industry trends, geopolitical factors, and other developments impacting cyber risk

Intelligence reporting and analysis

Move beyond isolated cases by identifying, documenting, and explaining sector-specific trends and patterns.
Clearly articulate operational and business impact relevant to the industry audience.

Meet the Team

Cisco’s Global Supplier Management (GSM) organization is an industry-leading sourcing team in supply chain responsible for orchestrating direct material spend portfolio across strategic hardware commodities. Within GSM, the Cost Operations team operates as the central nervous system for enterprise hardware cost governance and quarterly cost roll-ups. We architect analytical models and digital quoting workflows that empower global commodity teams to make faster, data-driven decisions that optimize product margins and maintain supply resilience.

Your Impact

As a Business Analyst in GSM Cost Operations, you will be a key driver of commodity cost intelligence, quarterly quote cycle governance, and digital transformation. You will lead end-to-end quarterly RFQ quoting cycles, partner with Commodity Managers to structure complex component pricing strategies, and build advanced models that eliminate cost gaps and mitigate spend variances. In this role, you will champion the adoption of modern Generative AI, machine learning tools, and automated agent workflows to transform operational quoting into a predictive, autonomous capability. This position offers visibility, cross-functional leadership opportunities, and a platform to shape the future of digital supply chain operations at scale.

What You'll Do

Lead Strategic Commodity Quoting & Cost Operations:
Orchestrate end-to-end quarterly and annual RFQ quoting cycles across assigned strategic hardware commodities. Govern quote intake, attribute drift analysis (MOQ, CT2R, COO, PSL, MPN lifecycle), and standard cost roll-ups in Oracle CG1 within strict fiscal timelines.

Architect Advanced Analytics:
Build dynamic simulative cost models and QoQ variance bridge models. Track and quantify cost, spend, savings, providing executive-ready insights.

Drive Cost Hole Governance & cost Variance Mitigation:
Identify cost holes, diagnose, and resolve missing component costs prior to quarter-end standard cost freezes. Oversee Purchase Price Variance (PPV) claim validations, supplier buydown liabilities, and Material Usage Variance (MUV) root-cause mitigation across manufacturing sites.

GenAI & Digital Workflow Automation:
Implement Generative AI tools, LLM prompt engineering, and automated agent workflows. Streamline supplier follow-ups and ideate and execute automation of manual activities.

Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process Excellence:
Partner closely with Supply channel Leads (SCL), Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain Product Managers, Finance, and Contract Manufacturers to resolve operational bottlenecks, enforce master data integrity (Control Codes, Sourcing Rules), and mentor junior analysts.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Finance, Operations Research, Economics, or a related quantitative field. (Master’s / MBA is a plus).

Experience:
6+ years of hands-on experience in hardware supply chain analytics, procurement cost engineering, direct material cost management, or financial operations within a high-tech or manufacturing environment.

Advanced Excel Mastery:
Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel for complex financial modeling, multi-tab data reconciliations, nested functions (INDEX-MATCH, XLOOKUP, dynamic arrays), and Power Query data transformations.

Financial Acumen:
Strong financial acumen to evaluate the cost impact of non-material spend and correlate sourcing and manufacturing metrics to anticipate, identify, and communicate business and financial impacts.

Business Intelligence & Data Modeling:
Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise analytical dashboards and data pipelines in Power BI or Tableau, with hands-on proficiency in SQL / Snowflake queries.

Generative AI & Automation:
Demonstrated experience utilizing Generative AI tools, LLM prompt engineering, and basic scripting to optimize analytical workflows and business processes.

Preferred Qualifications

Hardware Domain & Costing Mechanics:
Deep understanding of multi-tier hardware Bill of Materials (BOM) structures, component manufacturing cost drivers (wafer, assembly/test, packaging), and Non-Material Spend (PPV, Buydowns, MUV).

Enterprise Systems Acumen:
Working knowledge of enterprise ERP, PLM, and sourcing platforms. Ability to navigate in complex process environments. Utilize analytical and data driven approach to identifying solutions and decision making.

Executive Communication & Storytelling:
Outstanding ability to distill complex datasets into structured executive presentations

Leadership & Problem-Solving Agility:
Strong analytical problem-solving acumen, self-driven initiative, cross-functional influencing skills, and a passion for mentoring junior team members and driving continuous operational innovation.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Named Most Valuable Sports Agency by Forbes for eight consecutive years, CAA represents more than 2,000 of the world’s top athletes in football, baseball, basketball, hockey, soccer, in addition to coaches, on-air broadcasters, and sports personalities and works in the areas of broadcast rights, corporate marketing initiatives, social impact, and sports properties for sales and sponsorship opportunities. Founded in 1975, CAA is headquartered in Los Angeles, and has offices in New York, Nashville, Memphis, Chicago, Miami, London, Munich, Geneva, Stockholm, Shanghai, and Beijing, among other locations globally.

The Role

As part of CAA’s Global Safety & Security Organization, this role will be responsible for supporting the development of a programs designed to ensure CAA is prepared to operate safely through dynamic situations and events in the US and globally. The areas of focus for this role will be physical security operations, and support of emergency preparedness, and threat management. This role will report to Director of Global Physical Security.

The ideal candidate for this role will be a team player with versatile, operational and technical skills and the ability to execute on a range of tasks large and small. The day-to-day responsibilities for this individual will include physical security operations of our offices in the Northeast region, including security vendor management, daily review and risk assessment of potential threats and suspicious activity, documentation and security data management, supporting our security systems and technology initiatives, and collaboration with Tech, investigative research, mass communication system management, and support to the refinement of global protocols and procedures for emergencies, crisis management, and physical security operations. The right candidate will have a passion for keeping people safe and working collaboratively with others to get the job done.

Physical Security Operations
Develop, implement, and manage the strategic and tactical planning for the region's security programs in alignment with our physical security standards.
Demonstrate accountability for regional assets, facilities, employees, and global travelers.
Identify, develop, implement and maintain security processes across CAA to reduce risks, respond to incidents, and protect the company’s people, brand, and assets.
Develop and implement policies, procedures, standards, and training within the region under the direction of the global program leadership.
Work with in-region agencies, staff, and CAA functional leads (from HR, Legal, etc.) in directing the approach, deployment, and execution of locally-based investigations and risk-mitigation efforts (ensuring compliance with all local, provincial, and federal laws and regulations).
Maintain close relationships with high-level law enforcement, intelligence, and private sector counterparts, in collaboration with CAA security leadership.
Work with program leadership on local/regional implementation of security technology and platforms compatible with global strategy.
Collaborate with the Security Systems & Technology team to support and help execute security technology installations regionally.
Brief senior management on status of regional security issues and engage with security leadership on information sharing and best practices in risk mitigation.
Serve on regional crisis and incident response teams.
Build trust and work collaboratively with key stakeholders regionally.

(e.g. Suspicious Activities, Potential Threats, Unsolicited Material)

Reviewing and managing incoming digital information--documenting, assessing and escalating as appropriate.
Supporting threat and vulnerability assessment processes to ensure prioritization of mitigation efforts.
Providing tactical research/investigative/intelligence support to Global Safety & Security programs – to include conducting research using open source, subscription, and security-related services to monitor and assess current and emerging threats.
Monitoring emerging vulnerabilities with potential to impact the company or its people.
Conducting timely queries and research of both internal and external sources to support threat assessment, management, and response.
Preparing quantitative and qualitative reports identifying and contextualizing links, trends, and metrics.
Taking lead in executing process improvements for threat management.

Qualifications
Ten (10) years of work experience in enterprise security, law enforcement, investigations, crisis management, or other relevant fields
Strong tactical execution and project management skills

This role is a strong fit for is an experienced compliance, risk, or controls professional who is fluent in both their domain's subject matter and the mechanics of control design. identify deviations and drive corrective action

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Pacing
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Pacing is Anthropic's work to make sure that, as AI capabilities advance, enough time and effort goes into making them safe. It covers the safety commitments we make and carry out ourselves, the public policy we develop and support, and the research and communication that help people understand how quickly AI is progressing and what that could mean.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to run Pacing. It spans many projects led by people across Safety, Research, Policy, Legal, Communications, and Engineering, most of whom have other responsibilities too. You'll make sure each project has an owner, a clear outcome, and a date, and that leaders have high visibility and can make tradeoff decisions. You'll work closely with the team responsible for our Responsible Scaling Policy and support every project lead in delivering on their commitments.

The questions and strategies relevant to this program will change rapidly as the frontier evolves. You'll need enough technical depth to drive discussions about model training, evaluations, and compute, and the judgment to identify which decisions belong with cross-functional partners and which you can make yourself. We're looking for a generalist who can ship quickly and iteratively and drive accountability towards high-level, ambiguous objectives.

Key responsibilities

Own the Pacing program end to end, keeping one accurate view of projects, owners, milestones, dependencies, and gaps that drives action from leadership and project leads
Turn strategy from executive sponsors into scoped projects with measurable outcomes and timelines for execution, and drive concrete proposals to decisions
Run the operating rhythm, including working sessions with project leads, regular written updates, and effective executive reviews, and follow decisions and action items through to completion
Work with the Responsible Scaling Policy team and researchers to define the evidence and sign-off a model needs at key points in training and deployment, and make those reviews a dependable part of how we work
Track the public and internal commitments Anthropic makes on pacing, and sequence the work, publications, and events behind them with Policy and Communications
Partner with Legal throughout the lifespan of each project, and operate with high integrity on confidential and sensitive work
Define how progress is measured, report against it candidly, and recommend which projects and practices to continue, change, or stop
Use Claude to build automations to allow teams to have broader and deeper impact

Minimum Qualifications

Experience leading multiple complex technical programs that span organizations and involve engineering or research teams, from ambiguous goals through delivery
Strong program management skills, including program planning, milestone and dependency tracking, and risk management across many concurrent projects
Technical fluency sufficient to identify risks and challenge tradeoffs in how frontier AI models are trained, evaluated, and deployed
Working knowledge of AI safety and the main debates about how frontier AI should be developed and governed
A track record of delivering through senior leaders and teams who don't report to you, including when it meant changing how they work
Experience preparing decisions for executives, including framing options, making a recommendation, and recording the outcome
Sound judgment and discretion with confidential and sensitive information

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at a frontier AI developer, a government AI institute, an independent evaluator, or an AI safety or governance research organization
Hands-on experience with frontier AI safety work, such as safety frameworks, safety cases, risk reports, model evaluations, or reviews of model training or deployment
Familiarity with how AI progress is measured, including compute, capability trends, and the use of AI to speed up AI research

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Summary

The Marketing Analyst will play a critical role in supporting the B2B Marketing team by driving data driven decision making, reporting excellence, and seamless campaign execution.

The role will provide hands on support across marketing operations, lead management, campaign execution, and performance reporting, helping the team improve efficiency, increase conversion, and demonstrate measurable contribution to pipeline and business growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with marketing technology expertise and a practical, execution focused mindset.

Key Responsibilities

Own weekly lead reporting and dashboards, ensuring accurate visibility into marketing performance, pipeline contribution, lead progression, and conversion.
Develop leadership, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting, turning marketing and funnel data into clear insights and recommendations.
Manage webinar and virtual event setup through ON24 and Swoogo, supporting registration, execution, attendance tracking, and reporting.
Partner with Events, Sales, and Marketing teams to ensure lead capture, routing, follow up, and measurement processes are correctly established across campaigns and events.
Support QBRs and ongoing business reviews through data extraction, analysis, reporting, and identification of performance trends.
Serve as the team's expert for reporting tools, supporting dashboards, reporting, data analysis, and best practice adoption.
Act as the team's Automation expert, supporting campaign creation and setup, audience segmentation, target list exports, database management, testing, and deployment.
Maintain data quality and governance across marketing platforms to improve the reliability of campaign, audience, lead, and performance data.
Identify opportunities to automate and simplify processes, including the use of AI to reduce manual work and improve the speed and scalability of marketing operations.
Collaborate across B2B Marketing, Sales, Events, and Operations to continually improve campaign execution, measurement, lead management, and demand generation outcomes.Develop and implement comprehensive marketing plans in collaboration with account executives and stakeholders.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

2 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD).
Experience in marketing operations, campaign execution or marketing analytics.
Experience in data analysis, reporting and performance measurement.
Experience supporting the execution and measurement of marketing campaigns.
Strong working knowledge of Excel and experience working with marketing or customer data.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurately to deadlines.
Experience collaborating with cross functional teams and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD).
Hands on experience with marketing automation platforms such as Eloqua, Marketo or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including campaign setup, segmentation and database management.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar business intelligence tools, including building dashboards and extracting actionable insights.
Experience in B2B demand generation and lead management, including MQL to SQL conversion, lead routing and funnel reporting.
Experience with webinar and event platforms such as ON24 or Swoogo and associated lead capture and follow up processes.
Experience using AI, automation or workflow tools to improve marketing processes and operational efficiency.
Experience working in a complex, matrixed or multinational organization.

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Principal Data Analyst - Enterprise Services
jobs.description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or, a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Richmond, VA: $119,400 - $136,200 for Principal Data Analyst

jobs.description:
Description

Audit Data Analyst - Senior

Job Description

Huntington Bank is seeking a Senior Audit Data Analyst to join the Internal Audit Data Analytics team. In this role, you will use data analytics and technology to support audit testing, evaluate risks and controls, and provide data-driven insights across the organization.

You will partner with audit teams, business units, and technology partners to understand audit objectives, identify and evaluate relevant data, and develop analytical solutions that improve audit coverage and effectiveness. This position requires strong analytical and technical skills, an understanding of business and risk concepts, and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable information.

Job Responsibilities

Partner with audit teams to understand audit objectives, risks, processes, and controls and translate them into effective data-driven testing approaches.
Obtain, analyze, and validate large and complex datasets used to support audit engagements.
Develop testing populations and analytical procedures to evaluate risks and the effectiveness of internal controls.
Use SQL and other analytics tools to identify exceptions, anomalies, patterns, trends, and other insights relevant to audit objectives.
Develop repeatable and reusable analytical solutions that improve the efficiency and consistency of audit testing.
Support continuous auditing activities through recurring population analysis, exception identification, trend analysis, and reporting.
Evaluate data completeness, accuracy, transformation logic, and fitness for audit purposes and clearly document the work performed.
Identify opportunities to appropriately use automation, artificial intelligence, and emerging analytics capabilities to improve audit effectiveness and efficiency.
Clearly document analytical methodology, testing logic, assumptions, results, and conclusions in accordance with departmental standards.
Communicate analytical findings and complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Collaborate with colleagues across Internal Audit and with Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and business partners.
Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to other analysts and audit team members.
Contribute to the development and improvement of analytics standards, reusable code, methodologies, and testing libraries.
Stay current with developments in data analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, visualization, and audit technology.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, audit analytics, technology, risk management, internal audit,

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience using SQL to analyze large and complex datasets.
Experience translating business, risk, or audit objectives into data-driven analytical solutions.
Experience performing data validation, analytical testing, or population-based analysis.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical results to nontechnical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work both independently and collaboratively.
Degree or advanced coursework in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
Experience working in Internal Audit, Risk Management, Compliance, banking, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.
Experience developing population-based, exception-based, or continuous analytics.
Experience with Python or another data analysis or scripting language.
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Tableau.
Experience with automation, artificial intelligence, or emerging analytics technologies.
Experience designing repeatable or reusable analytical solutions.
Understanding of data quality, lineage, governance, and validation concepts.
Knowledge of banking processes, risks, regulations, and regulatory expectations.
Experience working directly with business and technology stakeholders on analytical initiatives.
Intellectual curiosity and demonstrated ability to learn and apply new technologies and analytical techniques.
