jobs.title: Business Analyst - Customer Insights & Growth
jobs.description:
Shoptet je jedna z nejrychleji rostoucích technologických společností v regionu. Pomáháme firmám i jednotlivcům snadno začít a rozvíjet jejich podnikání online. Nabízíme nekonečné možnosti pro e-shopy – od pronájmu, přes platební služby až po propojování s profesionály z oboru.

Hledáme business analytika, který nám pomůže lépe porozumět chování a potřebám zákazníků Shoptetu a identifikovat příležitosti pro další obchodní růst. Staneš se klíčovou součástí týmu Strategických iniciativ, kde budeš především analytickou podporou Commercial oddělení.

Zaměříš se na naše zákaznické portfolio i potenciál nových zákazníků – od retence a churnu přes upsell a cross-sell až po akviziční příležitosti, konkurenci a tržní trendy. Na základě svých zjištění budeš připravovat podklady pro business rozhodování a doporučovat konkrétní opatření. Pokud z identifikovaných příležitostí vzniknou projekty či iniciativy, zapojíš se také do jejich analytické podpory ve spolupráci s projektovými manažery.

Co bude tvojí náplní práce?

Analýza zákazníků a business příležitostí
Analýza stávajícího zákaznického portfolia, jeho vývoje a chování napříč platformou i jednotlivými službami.
Vyhodnocování retence, churnu, zákaznické hodnoty a příležitostí pro upsell a cross-sell.
Identifikace příležitostí pro získávání nových zákazníků a zvyšování efektivity akvizice.
Analýza zákaznických potřeb, konkurence, tržních trendů a obchodních modelů.
Propojování interních dat, zákaznické zpětné vazby, tržního researchu a dalších relevantních vstupů.
Business analýza a podpora rozhodování
Formulace hypotéz, klíčových rozhodovacích otázek a identifikace příčin problémů či nevyužitého potenciálu.
Návrh a vyhodnocování možných opatření včetně jejich očekávaných přínosů, nákladů a rizik.
Příprava analytických podkladů, business case a doporučení pro další rozhodování.
Spolupráce s obchodními, datovými a dalšími týmy na ověřování hypotéz a vyhodnocování výsledků.
Analytická podpora projektů a iniciativ
Spolupráce s projektovými manažery při přípravě a realizaci iniciativ vycházejících z identifikovaných business příležitostí.
Podpora při upřesňování zadání, požadavků, rozsahu a očekávaných přínosů projektů.
Příprava analytických výstupů podle potřeb projektu, včetně procesních modelů, use cases nebo funkčních specifikací.
Analytická podpora při testování, pilotním provozu a vyhodnocení dosažených výsledků.

Co od tebe očekáváme?

Co musíš umět

Umět vytvořit přehledné analytické výstupy a strukturované podklady pro business rozhodování.
Orientovat se v zákaznických datech, obchodních procesech a klíčových business metrikách.
Samostatně vyhledávat, propojovat, ověřovat a interpretovat data včetně rozpoznání jejich omezení a odlišení faktů od odhadů.
Formulovat hypotézy, hledat souvislosti a navrhovat realizovatelná doporučení.
Komunikovat jasně a srozumitelně s různými týmy, mít analytické a systémové myšlení, smysl pro detail a preciznost.

Co je výhodou

Zkušenosti s e-commerce, SaaS nebo analýzou zákaznického a obchodního chování.
Zkušenost s tématy retence, akvizice, churnu nebo obchodního růstu.
Základní znalost SQL nebo zkušenost s BI nástroji (Power BI, Metabase).

Job Description

Baker Tilly is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager
to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of complex AI technology programs across the firm's AI Product Group (APG). This role is responsible for establishing and managing an integrated delivery framework that aligns product development, engineering, platform operations, global teams, and external partners to ensure successful delivery of AI-enabled solutions. The position plays a critical role in driving program execution, managing cross-functional dependencies, enforcing production readiness and launch requirements, and ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, with measurable outcomes and clear accountability.

As a foundational member of the APG organization, this individual will serve as a strategic partner to senior technology leadership, providing oversight of program governance, technical delivery milestones, vendor commitments, and operational transitions. The ideal candidate combines deep technical program management expertise, strong understanding of AI/ML development and deployment, exceptional written communication, and the ability to influence across complex organizations. This role requires a highly proactive, results-oriented leader who can translate technical complexity into actionable plans, anticipate and resolve delivery risks, and establish scalable program management practices as the organization grows.

Responsibilities

Lead Enterprise AI Program Delivery: Own and manage integrated program execution across AI product management, engineering, platform operations, global delivery teams, and external partners, ensuring alignment of priorities, timelines, deliverables, and business objectives.
Drive Cross-Functional Program Management: Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, dependency maps, milestones, and delivery schedules spanning platform development, data pipelines, vendor integrations, security reviews, and production deployments.
Establish Program Governance and Accountability: Define and manage program governance processes, decision-making forums, escalation protocols, and delivery standards to ensure transparency, accountability, and timely resolution of issues.
Manage Production Readiness and Launch Gates: Coordinate and validate technical readiness requirements, including engineering evaluations, performance evidence, platform telemetry, security reviews, and acceptance criteria, to support informed production and launch decisions.
Oversee Vendor and Partner Delivery: Manage technical program coordination with external partners and vendors, track contractual milestones, validate integration requirements, and ensure vendor deliverables meet established technical standards and acceptance criteria.
Lead Knowledge Transfer and Operational Transition: Manage structured partner-to-internal-team transitions through defined shadowing, pairing, leadership, and ownership milestones, ensuring operational readiness and successful transfer of technical capabilities.
Drive Technical Collaboration and Delivery Alignment: Partner with engineering leaders, enterprise architects, product managers, and data platform teams to evaluate technical dependencies, challenge assumptions, assess delivery estimates, and proactively address risks impacting execution.
Manage Executive Reporting and Communications: Develop clear, concise, executive-level program updates, steering committee materials, quarterly business review presentations, escalation memoranda, and decision recommendations that communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and required actions.
Coordinate Global and Enterprise Stakeholders: Serve as a central program interface across U.S. and India engineering teams, enterprise technology, the Enterprise Transformation Office, People Solutions, and other stakeholders to align priorities and drive timely execution.
Establish Scalable Program Management Practices: Build and continuously improve program management tools, processes, reporting mechanisms, and operating cadences that support organizational growth, operational efficiency, and consistent delivery performance.
Support Strategic Initiatives: Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned to advance the firm's AI strategy and business priorities.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field,; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive technical program management experience, including leadership of complex, multi-team, multi-vendor technology initiatives and successful delivery of AI/ML solutions into production environments.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale technical programs with Director-level scope, including accountability for product launches, operational readiness, business outcomes, and delivery performance.
Proven expertise in program planning, cross-functional dependency management, milestone tracking, risk mitigation, resource coordination, and execution across multiple engineering and product teams.
Strong understanding of AI/ML development and deployment lifecycles, including model dependencies, evaluation frameworks, data readiness, agentic AI systems, and production release requirements.
Demonstrated ability to interpret technical architecture documentation, evaluate engineering estimates, and engage credibly with senior engineers and architects on complex technical delivery challenges.
Experience establishing and managing production readiness reviews, technical acceptance criteria, stage-gate processes, and evidence-based launch decisions.
Proven experience managing external technology vendors, contractual delivery obligations, technical acceptance requirements, and multi-vendor integration programs.
Experience leading structured knowledge transfer, operational transition, and partner-to-internal-team capability development initiatives.
Strong proficiency in technical program management methodologies, tools, and reporting frameworks, including dependency mapping, delivery tracking, risk management, and executive-level performance reporting.
Experience leveraging technical telemetry, engineering metrics, and delivery data to evaluate program health, validate progress, and support fact-based decision-making.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop executive-ready presentations, concise program updates, escalation memoranda, and actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to drive accountability and achieve results across teams and functions without direct reporting authority.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams, external partners, and enterprise stakeholders across multiple time zones and organizational structures.
Demonstrated success operating in fast-paced, evolving, or early-stage technology environments while establishing scalable processes within larger enterprise organizations.
Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges, resolve ambiguity, and manage competing priorities.
Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted and agentic tools to improve program management efficiency, accelerate execution, and enhance delivery outcomes.
No professional certifications or licenses required.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description
Fibertech Group is a technology and digital transformation partner headquartered in Riyadh, helping organizations build secure, scalable, and future-ready IT environments. The company delivers end-to-end solutions across cloud, on-premises infrastructure, hybrid environments, and networking using leading platforms such as Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform. Fibertech Group’s expertise spans cybersecurity, identity, compliance, AI solutions, intelligent automation, Microsoft 365, data and analytics, and business intelligence. The organization also provides managed services and 24/7 support to ensure reliable operations. Its approach focuses on aligning technology with business strategy to deliver secure, high-performance solutions with measurable impact.

Role Description

This full-time remote Information Technology Project Manager role is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing technology projects across cloud, infrastructure, security, and AI domains. The role includes defining project scope and objectives, creating detailed project plans, coordinating cross-functional teams, and managing timelines, budgets, and resources. The IT Project Manager will monitor project progress, mitigate risks, and ensure deliverables meet quality, security, and compliance standards. Day-to-day tasks include conducting stakeholder meetings, preparing status reports, managing vendor relationships, and aligning project outcomes with business goals. The role also involves continuous improvement of project management processes and supporting the adoption of new technologies and best practices.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to assess requirements, analyze risks, and interpret data-driven insights.
Candidates should possess Program Management and Project Planning skills to coordinate multiple initiatives, manage timelines, and oversee budgets and resources.
Candidates should possess Information Technology knowledge, including familiarity with cloud, infrastructure, security, and related enterprise technologies.
Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders, lead project teams, and present clear updates and documentation.
Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum are beneficial.
Experience managing IT projects in cloud, infrastructure, or cybersecurity environments is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is desirable.
Ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed team environment and manage projects across multiple time zones.

Position Description: Serve as daily point of contact for site construction team and owners’ representatives. Implement contract requirements with manufacturing partners and maintain ongoing communication of needs aligned with project schedule, documentation, and status. Manage coordination activities for assigned projects inclusive of operations, engineering, logistics, delivery and post-delivery support to achieve project goals.

Essential Duties & Key Responsibilities:

Establish productive and collaborative working relationships with site construction team, owners’ representatives, and manufacturing partners maintain ongoing communication of needs aligned with project schedule, documentation, and status.
In collaboration with project stakeholders, develop consensus for product delivery including budgets, emergent work, quality, safety, engineering, scheduling, installation, and close-out processes of assigned projects.
Oversee manufacturing partners’ adherence to commercial documents, including xPL contracts, product submittals, specifications, and applicable codes.
Align project processes and activities to maintain workflow in coordination with construction project delivery schedule and site construction team.
Verify project compliance with procedures to ensure quality, on-time, on-budget, delivery, and operational excellence to satisfy site construction team and owner’s representatives.
Provide continuous monitoring of manufacturing partners’ adherence to Quality Control Program , facilitate reviews and necessary modifications with vendors, site constructions team, and owner’s representatives.
Maintain routine presence at project job site to establish relationships, communicate needs, and fulfill client expectations.
Manage, resolve, and escalate issues in timely manner to site construction team and xPL stakeholders.
Present monthly project health reports to xPL management team, provide status of project finance and budget, staff monitors, schedule status, operational constraints, risk management, and recovery plans.
Manage project staffing levels for internal General Conditions/General Requirements (GC/GR) compliance and aligned with established financial structure of assigned project.
Provide regular performance feedback for assigned project staff during project and annual performance cycle, utilize talent management systems, and identify appropriate training to assist staff development.
Participate in internal xPL planning and lessons learned calls to establish efficiency for current workflows and operational standards.
Lead or participate in activities, duties, and responsibilities to ensure safe project delivery.
Other activities, duties, and responsibilities as assigned.
100% Remote role, no relocation necessary
Travel required = 30% to 40%

Bachelor’s Degree from accredited degree program in Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Management, or Supply Chain management or related field of study, with minimum of 8 years related experience required, or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
Experience managing geographically diverse, remote, and multidisciplined team
Strong decision making and relationship skills to identify constraints, progress issue resolution, and define ownership
Interpersonal and team building skills with ability to work across organizational levels, management, and stakeholders
Comprehensive knowledge and understanding of contract documents (including xPL contract, product submittals, specifications, codes)
Knowledge of estimating, construction costs, scheduling, purchasing and engineering principals and techniques
Ability to read and understand general contract and subcontract documents, drawings and specifications
Professional written and verbal communication with effective presentation delivery skills
Self-starter with project management skills and capable of managing concurrent complex projects and prioritizing tasks successfully to completion for self and others
Process and critical thinking skills with sound judgement decision-making
Organizational management skills, capable of managing and developing remote teams, observing performance, and delivering feedback
Proficient computer skills, Microsoft Office suite of applications, and knowledgeable of collaboration tools (e.g., Procore, ACC, SAP, Clearstory)
Knowledgeable of continuous improvement tools and methodologies

new_jobs.description:
Eaton’s North American Sales division is currently seeking a Project Manager - Hyperscale. This remote position is available to candidates located within the United States.

What You’ll Do

The primary function of a Field Based Project Manager is to create value and establish the project order management process as a key differentiator from our competitors. This position is heavily involved in the electrical and mechanical details of major strategic Datacenter project orders. The Project Manager is responsible for achieving sales goals and executing sales plans within an assigned sales territory and/or account. This position will need to achieve an assigned sales quota consistent with expectations of a seasoned professional sales engineer.

In This Function You Will

Manage the technical aspects of major electrical assembly project orders by meeting customer specifications and timelines for products, documentation, and quality
Secure and maintain distribution of products and services, while maintaining effective agreements
Manage and coordinate the sales effort within the customer/distributor base assigned while providing sales and technical assistance to distributors, contractors, and internal personnel
Utilize the Project Management team resources assigned to their project orders
Assess and apply in depth knowledge of sales planning services to internal clients in one or more specialty areas, requiring technical application
Upgrade existing processes, deploy new initiatives, and recommend new solutions based on analysis and customer trends
Ensure compliance with applicable processes and procedures to achieve business goals
Provide leadership and development to a sales team consisting of sales professionals, sales reps, and the distributor channel
Proactively use competitive information to leverage advantages of Eaton Corporation
Negotiate internally for resources and priorities needed for customers
Improve financial position for Eaton and the customer
Effectively manage business in all 4 time zones of the US, coordinating and leveraging resources in those time zones to provide timely and efficient solutions to internal and external stakeholder needs.

Qualifications

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution
Minimum 5 years’ of electrical industry experience
Minimum 2-years’ experience in project management.
Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.
Possess a valid and unrestricted driver’s license

2 years of experience managing mission critical datacenter electrical equipment in a manufacturing environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business or Electrical Engineering or related engineering field
Master’s degree
PMP Certification

Skills

POSITION CRITERIA:

Demonstrates customer ownership at multiple key accounts demonstrating leadership when working with stakeholders both internally and externally.
Ability to apply project management methodologies and strategies to reduce potential project risk throughout the duration of the project lifecycle.
Capable of planning and executing presentations on specific products and services to internal and external customers in order to gain recognition and customer acceptance.
Knowledge on plant front-end scheduling, engineering, and manufacturing process and equipment cycle times.
Possess advanced computer skills in word processing, spreadsheet, Vista, Salesforce, and Bidmanager
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of an assignment and customer satisfaction.
Consistent demonstration of planning, leading, and communication results from executive changes.
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and situations to achieve superior proactive project order management and customer service.
Travel up to 25% of the time.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $99000 - $145000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

new_jobs.title: Lead Technical Program Manager - Remote
new_jobs.description:
At Pencil, we are building the operating system for AI-powered marketing — a SaaS platform that uses Generative AI to redefine how the world's biggest brands plan, produce and deploy advertising. Our mission is to make AI the default in marketing without replacing creative people. To do that at the pace we're moving, our product and engineering teams have to move together without losing coherence. That is the work this role leads.

The Lead Technical Program Manager independently owns a portfolio of complex, cross-team programs that have a direct impact on the company: platform releases, integrations, technical migrations, and the engineering commitments we make to our most important clients. It sets the workback plans, dependency maps and operating cadence for those programs, and increasingly defines the methods and processes other program managers use.

A core part of this role is supporting the engineering requests and requirements of our Tier 1 clients. You will be the program owner who turns what our largest enterprise customers need into scoped, sequenced engineering work and who makes sure what we commit to them is realistic, tracked, and delivered.

This is a senior craft role. It doesn't own a product area and doesn't manage engineers directly. What it owns is rigour (the structure that keeps a fast-moving engineering team aligned) combined with the technical depth and judgement to apply that rigour credibly in an AI-native, agent-driven environment, and to help others in the TPM function do the same.

This role reports into the Principal Technical Program Manager and partners closely with engineering leads, product managers and client-facing teams. Remote, based in Canada, the US or LATAM, with regular working-hours overlap with our London-based teams.

Key Responsibilities

Tier 1 Client Engineering Requests

Own the program for engineering requests and requirements coming from our Tier 1 clients: intake, scoping, prioritisation input, sequencing and delivery tracking.
Partner with client-facing teams, product managers and engineering leads to translate client needs into clear, buildable requirements — and translate engineering reality back to the client side so commitments are realistic.
Enforce readiness gates before any date or scope is committed to a Tier 1 client, and keep a single trusted view of every open client commitment, its owner and its status.
Anticipate where client demands will collide with roadmap work and surface the trade-off early, with a recommended path, rather than letting it land as an escalation.

Operating Rhythm & Cadence

Design and run the operating cadence for your area of the product and engineering organisation, and help shape the cadence used across the wider TPM function.
Apply the minimum viable structure that keeps teams aligned without slowing them down: enough ceremony to make decisions stick, never more.
Ensure decisions get made on time, with the right people in the room, and with a written trail of what was decided and why.
Support (not own) the recurring sprint rhythm — planning, standups, retros and demos — and coordinate larger retrospectives across teams when a program or incident calls for one.

Workback Planning & Dependency Management

Own the workback plans and dependency maps for the programs in your portfolio — releases, integrations, client commitments and cross-team engineering work.
Hold the full picture for your programs when everyone else is heads-down: what depends on what, who owns what, what is about to slip, and what needs to be escalated.
Keep your project management tool (e.g. Linear) trustworthy enough that its views can be read without a verbal check: issues correctly labelled, estimated, assigned and in the right state.
Own the standing views the organisation relies on — production bugs, in-flight work, blocked items, client commitments — so status is a link, not a meeting.
Actively reduce complexity: automate status collection, reporting and tracker hygiene wherever possible, and lead adoption of new tools and AI-native workflows that make the function faster.
Surface technical and timeline risk early, challenge optimistic plans, and enforce readiness gates before commitments are made externally.

Cross-Team Program Delivery

Independently run the programs that require multiple teams to move together — feature launches, client integrations and technical migrations — including those with company-level impact.
Determine the methods and approach for new or ambiguous programs: scope, sequence and drive them to delivery, owning the schedule, the trade-offs and the comms back to stakeholders.
Manage the seams between teams — where product hands off to engineering, engineering hands off to another workstream, and client-facing teams hand off to delivery.
Resolve cross-team blockers directly, going lead-to-lead to clear dependencies so coordination doesn't need to escalate upward.
Put out fires before they cause harm: spot the program that is drifting and act on it independently.

Risk, Escalation & Decision Support

Apply and refine the escalation framework: flag what is on track, what is at risk, and what needs a leadership call — and make sure the right call gets made.
Own the first-responder rota for incidents and client interrupts in your area, absorbing and routing them before they land on a team mid-flow.
Provide expert advice on complex delivery decisions that affect other teams or the company at large.
Translate engineering reality for non-technical stakeholders and back again, so no one is surprised by scope or timeline.
Produce a trustworthy weekly written status for stakeholders and leadership — a one-pager when it's a one-pager moment, a full dependency map when it isn't.

Goal Tracking

Support engineering and product leads on OKR reporting and tracking: keeping objectives and key results current, surfacing progress and drift each cycle, and turning them into a readable rollup so goal health is visible without a separate chase.

Growing the TPM Function

Create, not just improve, the templates, cadences and trackers used across the TPM function, and make sure they outlast you.
Mentor and actively support more junior program managers, and coordinate their activities on shared programs where needed.
Act as an ambassador for our values in how programs are run and in TPM hiring, including taking part in interview loops.
Stay current with how leading AI-native engineering organisations run delivery, and bring the best ideas back to Pencil.

Explicitly Not Owned

People management, performance, growth, and hiring decisions — stay with engineering leadership and team leads.
Technical decisions and architecture — owned by engineering leadership.
Priority and product direction — owned by Product Managers.
The commercial client relationship — owned by client-facing teams; this role owns the engineering delivery behind it.

Your Background

8+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager, ideally in AI/ML, platform infrastructure, or developer tooling.
Track record independently running complex programs with multi-team dependencies, hard external deadlines and company-level impact.
Experience owning engineering delivery for enterprise or Tier 1 clients: managing their requests, setting realistic commitments, and keeping them informed without over-promising.
Genuine technical fluency: comfortable reading a system architecture and understanding the implications; comfortable in conversations about APIs, integration design, and platform trade-offs without being the engineer in the room.
Engineering background a strong plus — many of the best program managers we've worked with came up through engineering before moving into the discipline.
Structured thinker who writes clean documents: takes ambiguity, incomplete specs and competing stakeholder views and produces a clear framing with a recommended path.
Communication at every altitude: a crisp update for leadership, a detailed dependency map for a tech lead, a clear status for a client-facing team, and the judgement to know which the situation calls for.
Experience mentoring other program managers and creating the templates, cadences and norms a young TPM discipline runs on.
A track record of bringing in new tools or ways of working that measurably reduced overhead for the teams around you.
Bonus: experience in a high-growth scale-up, and/or experience in a company building infrastructure while simultaneously using it on real customer workloads.

KPIs & Success Measures

Tier 1 client engineering commitments are delivered on time, with risks raised to client-facing teams before dates slip, not after.
Every open Tier 1 client request has a named owner, a status and a realistic date that can be read from a single view.
An operating rhythm for your area that runs on time, with clear inputs and decisions out — measured by stakeholder satisfaction and meeting hygiene.
Workback plans and dependency maps that exist, are current, and are trusted by the people they describe — measured by usage and reduction in unplanned slippage.
On-time delivery of the cross-functional programs in your portfolio, with material risks raised before they become crises.
Reduction in escalations reaching senior leadership that should have been resolved within your programs.
Team leads escalate delivery blockers to you, not upward — and client interrupts hit a named first responder, not whoever is nearest the code.
A trustworthy weekly status exists without leadership having to assemble it themselves.
New processes, templates and automations you created are adopted beyond your own programs and used across the TPM function.
More junior program managers you mentor grow measurably in scope and independence.

Benefits

25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme.
Health insurance / private medical cover.
Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development.
Remote — work from anywhere in your home country within Canada, the US or LATAM.
Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy.
Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London, when you're there.
Flexible working hours.

About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made — because AI ads are faster and cheaper to make, and better performing, than making them without AI.

We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement — it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones), with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is a leading global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with a majority of the world's top global advertisers. Clients include Banco Itau, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

https://www.thebrandtechgroup.com

new_jobs.title: Product Owner / Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

About ClearConnect Solutions

At ClearConnect Solutions, an Acrisure company, we believe there’s a story in your data, and we help our clients see it. We specialize in cutting-edge, data-driven technology solutions for fleet insurers, underwriters, and policyholders. From real-time risk score monitoring, automated Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) services, and screening platforms to advanced telematics and route optimization, our software empowers the transportation and insurance industries to mitigate risk, streamline compliance, and build safer driver workforces.

We are expanding our software development capabilities and looking for a dynamic Product Owner / Project Manager to bridge the gap between business strategy and agile execution.

Job Summary

The Product Owner / Project Manager serves a dual-purpose role, driving product vision, backlog, and requirements while keeping the software development team aligned, unblocked, and on schedule. This role owns the product lifecycle from concept through deployment for data and risk-management platforms, leads agile ceremonies, develops precise user stories, and partners with engineering, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable features for the fleet and insurance sectors.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Requirements Engineering

Backlog Management: Own, prioritize, and groom the product backlog, ensuring user stories align with strategic business goals and product roadmaps.
Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with internal stakeholders, data analysts, and industry experts to translate complex data workflows, including MVR automation, telematics, and risk scoring, into clear, actionable technical requirements.
User Story Creation: Write detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications that provide clear direction for software developers and QA teams.
Product Roadmap Support: Assist leadership in defining release scopes, tracking milestones, and aligning software releases with company growth objectives.

Project Management & Scrum Leadership

Scrum Ceremonies: Lead agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Sprint Execution & Delivery: Manage sprint velocity, remove blockers, and help the engineering team deliver high-quality code on schedule.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary communication conduit between technical teams and business stakeholders, manage expectations, and provide transparent project-status updates.
Process Improvement: Continuously optimize agile workflows, tools, and documentation practices to improve team efficiency.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Project Manager, or Scrum Master in an Agile software development environment.
Strong familiarity with software development life cycles (SDLC), API integrations, and data-heavy platforms.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business language and business needs into technical requirements.
Analytical mindset and comfort working with complex data systems, risk models, and compliance workflows to define logical product solutions.
Proficiency with agile project management and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.

Preferred Qualifications

Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or an equivalent agile certification.
Experience with SaaS, InsurTech, FinTech, fleet-management technology, or related data-driven platforms.
Experience supporting products involving MVR automation, telematics, risk scoring, screening, compliance, or route optimization.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
An opportunity to shape innovative software products in the rapidly evolving InsurTech and fleet-safety space.
A collaborative, data-driven culture that values continuous learning and professional growth.

Pay Details:

The base compensation range for this position is $85,000 - $85,000. This range reflects Acrisure's good faith estimate at the time of this posting. Placement within the range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, location, and internal equity.

Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

Why Join Us:

At Acrisure, we’re building more than a business, we’re building a community where people can grow, thrive, and make an impact. Our benefits are designed to support every dimension of your life, from your health and finances to your family and future.

Making a lasting impact on the communities it serves, Acrisure has pledged more than $22 million through its partnerships with Corewell Health Helen DeVos Children's Hospital in Grand Rapids, Michigan, UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Blythedale Children's Hospital in Valhalla, New York.

Employee Benefits

We also offer our employees a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks, including:

Physical Wellness: Comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; fertility benefits; wellness resources; and paid sick time.
Mental Wellness: Generous paid time off and holidays; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and a complimentary Calm app subscription.
Financial Wellness: Immediate vesting in a 401(k) plan; Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options; commuter benefits; and employee discount programs.
Family Care: Paid maternity leave and paid paternity leave (including for adoptive parents); legal plan options; and pet insurance coverage.
… and so much more!

This list is not exhaustive of all available benefits. Eligibility and waiting periods may apply to certain offerings. Benefits may vary based on subsidiary entity and geographic location.

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. Applicants may request reasonable accommodation by contacting leaves@acrisure.com .

Final candidates will be required to complete post-offer verification processes related to the role and in accordance with applicable laws.

new_jobs.title: Technology Project Manager - Cybersecurity
new_jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused
team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious
team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed
— we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We are looking for a Technology Project Manager who likes high-accountability environments. This is not a box-ticking, follow-the-process job. It is about driving outcomes, building predictability, clearing the path for others, and making sure our security initiatives land on time and at quality. You will work across security, engineering, infrastructure, compliance, legal, product, and operations to bring clarity, momentum, and delivery discipline without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Sitting within the Technology Project Management function of our group-wide PMO, you will support a portfolio of information security projects and programs: control implementation and remediation, PCI DSS and ISMS compliance work, audit readiness, vendor security assessments, tooling and automation rollouts, and security awareness initiatives.
Your success will be measured by your ability to make us more predictable, remove friction, and keep complex security initiatives moving forward. You are the person who sees the risk coming, fixes the issue before it becomes a blocker, and creates the space for the security team to do their best work.

What You Will Deliver

Predictable security roadmaps, with clear visibility of progress, risks, mitigations, and trade-offs so leadership can make confident decisions.
Comprehensive project plans covering timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and dependencies across security and compliance workstreams.
Momentum across teams, ensuring cross-functional workstreams, auditors, and external vendor groups stay aligned, connected, and unblocked.
Smooth delivery, where issues are raised early, solutions are proposed quickly, and security complexity is simplified for the organization.
Security solutions that meet regulatory obligations and align with industry best practices, including PCI DSS, ISMS, ISO 27001, and NIST.
Audit readiness, with internal and external audits, vendor security assessments, and evidence requests coordinated well ahead of the deadline rather than in a last-minute scramble.
Operational efficiency, through the smart use of AI and automation to streamline reporting, tracking, and communication.
Improved ways of working, bringing lightweight structure, repeatable habits, and continuous improvement to security processes and controls.
A security-aware culture, reinforced through clear documentation, templates, and enablement rather than policing.
Stakeholder confidence, through transparent updates, clear security performance metrics, and the ability to translate technical detail into what matters most, including at the Security and Privacy Steering Committee (SPSC).

How You Work

You have a “get it done” mindset, always pushing for clarity and forward progress.

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager - Rack Integration
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Hiring Locations:
Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US

About The Department

The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.

About The Role

As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. In this senior individual contributor role, you will coordinate the transition of servers and network equipment from server-level manufacturing (L10) into complete rack integration (L11), providing global partners with the material readiness, capacity planning, and operational visibility needed to execute Cloudflare’s global expansion.

What You’ll Do

Drive Strategic Supply Planning: Connect capacity requirements with L10 hardware availability and L11 rack manufacturing schedules to maintain scalable supply plans across global regions.
Manage Material & Production Readiness: Oversee weekly supply allocation reporting, shortage reviews, and material-readiness assessments for upcoming rack integration builds.
Guide Operational Tradeoffs: Identify supply constraints and present actionable allocation options to Capacity Planning, evaluating tradeoffs between direct hardware shipping and complete rack integration.
Translate Long-Term Strategy: Convert quarterly and annual capacity forecasts into actionable operational requirements for L11 integration partners.
Monitor Program Financials & Progress: Track CapEx commitments against rack integration and deployment plans, giving leadership visibility into utilization, execution progress, and delivery risks.
Lead Supplier Relationships: Partner with global L11 integration providers through regular business reviews covering capacity, delivery, cost, quality, and performance.
Expand Resilient Manufacturing: Evaluate and recommend new L11 suppliers and build locations to strengthen geographic resiliency, capacity growth, and technical standards.
Support Commercial Operations: Validate supplier requisitions, purchase orders, and commercial agreements while supporting leadership approval workflows.
Partner on Global Supply Risk Mitigation: Collaborate with Capacity Planning, Procurement, and Hardware Sourcing to identify and mitigate rack integration risks involving capacity bottlenecks, logistics hurdles, tariffs, and regional concentration.
Partner on New Product Introductions (NPI): Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and rack integration teams to translate evolving hardware designs into operational preproduction and build readiness plans.
Support Supplier Quality: Analyze supplier-performance trends, coordinate escalations, and track cross-functional quality and engineering issues through resolution.
Operationalize ERP Workflows: Support adoption and stabilization of the team’s Oracle ERP processes, then identify improvements to planning, reporting, controls, and operational efficiency.
Deliver Executive Insights: Create clear forecasts, operational reporting, and risk assessments for leadership review.
Scale the Operating Model: Establish sustainable operational frameworks that expand production capacity while maximizing efficiency.

Required Qualifications

Broad professional experience in global supply chain management, production planning, manufacturing operations, or a related field.
Proven track record coordinating supply and production programs across multi-site manufacturing environments and international regions.
Demonstrated skill in connecting demand forecasts, material readiness, supplier capacity, and manufacturing schedules.
Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs across engineering, procurement, finance, and external vendors.
Strong analytical skills with expertise in supply modeling, risk assessment, and operational reporting.
Demonstrated capability to manage supplier performance and lead business reviews at both operational and executive levels.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting strategic options and risks to leadership.
Ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones.

Desirable / Preferred Qualifications

Experience with contract manufacturing (CM), original design manufacturers (ODM), or systems integrators for data center, server, or network hardware.
Experience managing, optimizing, or stabilizing supply chain processes within an enterprise ERP platform (preferably Oracle).
Experience evaluating manufacturing partners, leading supplier assessments, or managing RFP processes.
Background in supporting commercial negotiations, procurement agreements, and supplier capacity commitments.
Familiarity with hardware new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transition processes.
Knowledge of global supply risk management, including tariff mitigation, logistics planning, and regional diversification.
Experience using performance scorecards and operational metrics to drive supplier accountability.
Willingness to travel occasionally for supplier site visits and operational reviews.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $138,000 - $189,000
For New York, Washington DC, Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $130,000 - $179,000
For Austin Texas based hires: Estimated annual salary of $108,000 - $149,000

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. About Tigris

Logistics still runs on emails, Excel and phone calls. Every company in the logistics chain keeps its own version of the truth, and billions of dollars move on data nobody can fully trust.  
That's about to change!  
Tigris connects all those scattered systems into one live picture of vessels, cargo and schedules, so every company in the chain can work from data it can trust. On top of that, AI agents read the documents, watch the ships, predict what's coming and make the calls people still make by hand today. It's a mix of AI, data and real-world operations that almost nobody is building yet.  
We're starting in maritime, the hardest place to get it right, and building it for any company to run on. If you want to build something that doesn't exist yet, this is the place.  

Why we're hiring now

After three years of building, Tigris is live with its first customer and has a growing pipeline of logistics businesses behind it. We're a small, hands-on team in the City of London, and we're now hiring the people who will turn a working platform into a scaling business.  
We build system software and algorithms at the same time, and more customers means more moving parts. We need someone to make sure the right work is clearly defined, properly sequenced and shipped.  

The role

Leadership sets the direction of the system. Your job is to turn that direction into clear, buildable work and drive it through to delivery.  
As our Technical Program Manager, you'll be the organising layer between vision and engineering. You'll close ambiguity, manage dependencies and keep delivery moving across our system software and algorithm workstreams. It's a hands-on execution role: you'll spend most of your time with engineers, writing specifications, untangling dependencies and getting work over the line.  
You'll report to our CTO and work daily with our Head of Engineering, engineers, Product Manager and UI/UX designer, and give senior leadership a clear view of where delivery stands. The Product Manager owns what we build and why, and engineering owns how it's built; you own sequencing, triage, UAT and release.  

What you'll do

Lead delivery across our system software and algorithm workstreams  
Write clear technical requirements and specifications that engineers can build from, agreed with our Head of Engineering  
Turn the Product Manager's priorities into a delivery plan that fits the team's capacity, and make sure work is well defined and ready before it's picked up  
Own sequencing, triage, UAT and release  
Identify and manage dependencies, risks and blockers across workstreams, and escalate early when something can't be resolved  
Work day to day with engineers to clarify scope, unblock issues and keep delivery on track  
Recommend release go / no-go decisions to our Head of Engineering  
Give our CTO and Head of Engineering clear visibility of progress, risks, capacity and timelines  
Create regular, metric-focused reports for senior leadership  
Work with our Product Manager and UI/UX designer so system capabilities reach customers in a form they can use  
Capture what customers need to build but can't yet, with our Product Manager, and feed it into planning  
Design lightweight processes that keep a small team aligned without slowing it down  

What we're looking for

Experience as a Technical Program Manager, Release Manager or in a similar technical coordination role  
A track record of running complex, cross-functional technical programmes through to delivery  
Strong technical writing: you create clarity, not ambiguity  
Technical fluency: you don't need to write code, but you're comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines and system architecture with engineers  
The ability to drive delivery without direct authority, with strong communication and negotiation skills across engineers, leadership and customers  
Organised and detail-oriented, with good instincts for what needs to be written down and what needs talking through  

Nice to have

Experience at a system or infrastructure company (B2B, developer tools or similar)  
Background in logistics, supply chain or operations technology  
Exposure to data systems or algorithm-driven systems  
A technical background (engineering, data or similar)  

Why join us

Real ownership.
Every role here makes an impact. You'll shape how a team building system software and algorithms at once plans and ships its work.  
A hard, unsolved problem.
We're not building a feature. We're building infrastructure that an entire industry can run on.  
Real momentum.
We have live production systems, a live customer and carrier integrations covering more than 90% of major trade lanes.  
Built for the long term.
Our backing comes from within the shipping industry, not external venture capital, so we're not on someone else's timeline. It also gives us direct access to industry expertise, introductions and data, and a natural path to customers.  
Close to leadership.
A small, hands-on team with direct access to leadership: your work is visible, and so is your impact.  
AI-native from day one.
We use the best AI tools every day, so a small team can move fast and ship in weeks, not quarters.  

Compensation & benefits

Competitive salary  
Private health & dental cover  
25 days' holiday  
Enhanced parental leave  
Best-in-class hardware  
Extensive perks, including WeWork office benefits and regular team building  
Great culture & monthly socials  
Learning & development opportunities

fleet solution – from Alpha prototype to production version, and from early adoption to mass deployment and further to different version obsolescence.

new_jobs.description:
About Clay

AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential.

Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. We're already helping thousands of customers — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Visa — go to market with unique data, signals, and AI research.

In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education.

Some Things To Know About Us

Our community includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs, and 30k members on Slack.
Our culture is unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more.
All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more.
Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here.
Read about us in the NYT, Forbes, First Round Review, and more.

Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor page!

Product Operations @ Clay

As Clay continues to scale, privacy and compliance have become core to how we operate and build trust with our customers. We're looking for a GRC Program Manager to build and own the operational systems that keep us compliant across vendor management, data privacy, and security. You'll be creating scalable processes from scratch to support teams across the company as they onboard vendors and handle customer information. You'll work at the intersection of engineering, security, legal and business teams to build processes that scales with our growth.

What You'll Do

Vendor Onboarding & Risk Management: Build and own the end-to-end vendor onboarding compliance process. When teams want to onboard a new vendor, conduct proper review (DPA, SOC 2/GDPR data compliance), update our subprocessor list, and manage customer notifications
GRC Vendor Management: Serve as the internal owner and point of contact for external GRC vendors. Manage intake, ticketing, SLAs, quality review, and performance metrics to ensure security and compliance requests are tracked, resolved, and continuously improved
Compliance Reviews: Build processes for and complete compliance reviews when teams evaluate purchasing new data sets and vendor compliance.
Cross-Functional Program Building: Create operational processes and systems from scratch to scale compliance work across the company. You'll own programs end-to-end, not just coordinate projects
Customer Security Support: Assist in responding to security and privacy questionnaires from prospective and existing customers, with a particular focus on privacy, data protection, and compliance-related questions

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
5+ years of experience building and scaling operational programs, ideally in a SaaS or tech environment
Strong builder mindset: you're excited to create processes and systems from scratch, not just maintain existing ones
Understanding of privacy laws and frameworks (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, etc.) with the ability to apply them practically across vendor management, data flows, and employee compliance
Experience with vendor risk assessments, security questionnaires, and DPA/subprocessor management
Familiarity with DSAR processes and compliance tools like Vanta, Transcend, or similar platforms
Excellent project management skills with the ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives to completion
Strong communication skills for partnering with legal, engineering, data teams, and business stakeholders
Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and adapt in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Bonus Points

Knowledge of additional compliance standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2)
Experience with data mapping, privacy impact assessments (PIAs), or incident response in a privacy context
Technical aptitude for understanding SaaS infrastructure and data flows

. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in program management.
Experience with data centers operations or data center security.
Experience with storage media.

Preferred qualifications:

5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
Experience writing technical business requirements documents and partnering with software/automation engineering teams to enforce process compliance.
Experience with hardware decommissioning, reverse logistics, NPI launch, hardware manufacturing, supply chain operations, material management, or technical operations.
Familiarity with global standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and NIST 800-53/88.
Knowledge of physical security systems and their intersection with logical security, specifically the birth-to-death Chain of Custody for storage media (HDD/SSD/flash/tape shredding, crushing, and cryptographic/logical sanitization), encryption, and hardware asset tracking.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Google's Data Centers are the foundation of our global operations. We are seeking a experienced Technical Program Manager to lead transformative media security initiatives across our data center fleet modernizing and optimizing our media handling operations while keeping data safe. This role requires a technical background, program management expertise, and ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance our security posture, ensure compliance, and manage risk. You will be responsible for large-scale, complex programs that have a direct impact on the security, resilience, and efficiency of Google's data centers.

Our team helps maintain user trust by keeping their data safe. We protect against unauthorized access and prevent loss of assets that may contain intellectual property or our customers' sensitive data across our global data center fleet.

We accomplish this through developing policies, guidelines, processes, and tools that help ensure we meet Google’s data security commitments. Engineering operational issues away to reduce time, touches, and cost. Engineering & business enablement through data security audit management and monitoring of process compliance.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Lead transformative initiatives to modernize, optimize, and scale media handling and lifecycle operations across our global data center fleet while keeping Google's and our customers data safe.
Partner with cross-functional engineering, hardware, supply chain, logistics, and operations teams to re-imagine legacy workflows, engineer operational issues away, and uphold strict media chain-of-custody controls.
Drive end-to-end technical program execution from defining requirements, policies, and process standards to global deployment, risk management, and continuous compliance monitoring.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Controls Management
new_jobs.description:
Meta's RCP function enables the company to build products that withstand regulatory scrutiny and meet global privacy, security, and integrity obligations at scale. Within RCP, Controls Management owns the lifecycle of Meta's compliance controls: how controls are designed, documented, implemented, changed, and monitored across the privacy, security, and integrity domains, as well as emerging domains such as AI.We are seeking a Program Manager to own and drive strategic initiatives across one or more control portfolios, with a scope that may span the Privacy, Security, and Integrity domains as priorities evolve. You will be the connection point between Controls Management, first-line control owners, Legal, Regulatory Readiness, Risk, Assurance, and Examinations and Audit. This role is a strong fit for is an experienced compliance, risk, or controls professional who is fluent in both their domain's subject matter and the mechanics of control design. You should be able to make progress on loosely defined problems by clarifying scope, identifying dependencies, and proposing actionable next steps, able to manage competing priorities against regulatory deadlines, and able to translate between legal requirements, risk teams, and the engineering and operations teams who own and run the controls.

Program Manager, Controls Management Responsibilities:

Own the end-to-end control lifecycle for the controls in your scope (intake, design, documentation, activation, and change management) in line with Meta's control framework and minimum standards
Translate regulatory obligations, legal interpretations, and risk assessment findings into control objectives, control designs, and evidence expectations for first-line, technical, and operational teams
Partner with first-line control owners across product, engineering, operations, and data teams to design and document controls that are defensible, testable, and adoptable
Map controls to obligations, risks, and control objectives, keeping traceability current as regulations, products, and controls change
Govern changes to controls through change management, assessing the impact on coverage, monitoring, and downstream assurance
Maintain the accuracy and consistency of the control inventory in Meta's compliance systems, including metadata, ownership, and risk and objective linkages
Drive control rationalization: consolidating, deprecating, or uplifting controls to reduce duplication and raise them to a consistent bar across domains
Support the onboarding of new or emerging compliance domains into the shared control lifecycle, including domain structure, ownership models, and design standards
Prepare controls and control owners for assurance and audit, partnering with Assurance and Examinations and Audit on readiness, walkthrough narratives, and evidence
Maintain an in-depth understanding of the evolving regulatory landscape in your domain and translate changes into control framework updates
Define, monitor, and report metrics that give leadership visibility into control health, design throughput, and remediation progress
identify deviations and drive corrective action
Develop and own communication plans that keep stakeholders aligned on status, risks, and decisions
Produce written analyses, recommendations, and presentations for senior leadership and cross-functional partners
Identify gaps in processes, systems, and tooling, and drive scalable improvements, including automation and AI-enabled workflows
Represent Controls Management in cross-organizational initiatives, providing control design expertise

Minimum Qualifications:

6+ years of experience in compliance, risk management, audit, privacy, information security, trust and safety, program management, or a related field
Experience designing, implementing, or evaluating control frameworks in a complex, cross-functional environment
Experience translating regulatory or policy requirements into operational processes or controls
Experience communicating risk findings and recommendations in writing to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership
Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams by prioritizing based on impact, urgency, and stakeholder needs

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt and context engineering, agent orchestration), and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Subject-matter experience in one or more of: privacy and data protection, information security, trust and safety, or content integrity, third-party risk, or AI governance
Experience working with engineering teams in a technical environment to design or automate control systems
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize or redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
Experience in supporting external audits, regulatory examinations, or independent assessments
Experience using data tools or dashboards to monitor control health and surface actionable insights
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

$122,000/year to $180,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits
